ids.discriminators: The source row's own id for a role that occurs more than once in a step (ask, pause, hub-exec); empty otherwise. A runner span's is the lease id for runner/worker, `<generation>/<kind>` for runner/invocation, and its source row's id for the other runner roles.

lifetime_span.discriminator: Empty for the root; the step key for a step span; the instant the span begins as UTC `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` for a wait or the marker.

ids.parents: Every step and gate root has the work root as its parent; the work root is its trace's root. Every lifetime step span, wait and marker has the lifetime root as its parent; the lifetime root is its trace's root. A runner worker span's parent is its attempt's step root.
ids.zero_rule: An all-zero digest has its last byte set to 01.

spans.meaning: One runner or hub attempt at a node, the root of a step, under the work root.
spans.name: step <node>

spans.meaning: One human decision at a node, the root of a step, under the work root.
spans.name: gate <node>

spans.meaning: The chunk waiting claimable, pauses excluded.
spans.name: queue wait

spans.meaning: From the claim to the runner starting the step.
spans.name: claim

spans.meaning: A question to a person, from asked to answered.
spans.name: ask

spans.meaning: The fleet paused during the step.
spans.name: pause

spans.meaning: From a person deciding a gate to the decision being picked up.
spans.name: decision pickup

spans.meaning: A hub node's run holding its execution slot.
spans.name: hub exec

spans.meaning: The chunk's work, from its first step's start to its first terminal fact, `done` or `stopped`, the root of its work trace. Told once, when the chunk finishes.
spans.name: chunk work

spans.meaning: The chunk from ingest to its first terminal fact, `done` or `stopped`, the root of its lifetime trace. Told once, when it finishes.
spans.name: chunk

spans.meaning: One step or gate of the chunk, named for its node, under the lifetime root; links to the step's root in the work trace. It runs from the start of the step's queue wait and claim, else its start, but never before the end of the previous step span or of a backlog or escalation wait that ended by its start, and never after its own start, to the later of its end and its close, so a gate's decision pickup is inside it; step spans never overlap, and it carries the step's wait totals. The work root keeps the role `chunk` for its unchanged span id; the lifetime spans are `chunk/*`.
spans.name: <node>

spans.meaning: A stopped chunk hand-completed, a zero-length span at the completion under the lifetime root.
spans.name: chunk completed

spans.meaning: The chunk resting `not_ready`, from ingest to its first promotion, its first lease or its finish, less what a step span covers.
spans.name: backlog wait

spans.meaning: The chunk parked `needs_human`, from the escalation to the requeue, restart, migration restart or lease mint that released it, less what a step span covers.
spans.name: escalation wait

spans.meaning: The chunk paused while no step span and no other chunk wait covered it, from the pause (or the end of the step span it began in) to the resume.
spans.name: pause wait

spans.meaning: One runner lease, from its minting to its close, parented to the hub's step root.
spans.name: worker <node>

spans.meaning: One harness invocation in the lease; plain `invoke_agent` when the node declares no session.
spans.name: invoke_agent <session>

spans.meaning: The worker parked on a question until it resumed.
spans.name: parked on ask

spans.meaning: The worker parked by a fleet pause until it resumed.
spans.name: parked on pause

spans.meaning: The worker backing off after the provider reported overload.
spans.name: provider overload backoff

spans.meaning: A person took the worker's session over, until they handed it back.
spans.name: takeover
